       1 The Penguin                                      
       2                                                                                                                                                                                              
       3 He stands upon the ice in tuxedo black and white,
       4 a formal figure facing the polar wind.                                                                                                                                                                             
       5 He waddles down the slope with awkward delight

       7                                                                                                                                                                                                                    
       8 Beneath the waves he flies with powerful wings,                                                                                                                                                                  
       9 a torpedo sleek and swift through the cold blue.                                                                                                                                                                   
      10 He hunts the krill and fish and sings and sings,
